Thanks again for the call this morning  great to learn more about Novamed's workflow and the data flows you described. As discussed, attaching the SIG starter spreadsheet your security team can fill out ("Novamed_SIG_request.xlsx"). To keep things moving, a suggested intake process below:

2) Residency/regulatory needs: Do you require data to remain in a specific region (US-only, or state-located data centers)?
3) Retention: Typical retention window vs any legal hold requirements?
4) Connectors: Which cloud connectors or SSO providers should we expect (Okta, Azure AD, SAML)?

Marissa (CCd) is our Security & Compliance lead  shell handle the questionnaire and can jump on a 30-min technical call if helpful.

Thanks  Ill follow up with our security summary this afternoon.

Hi Camila 

Thanks for the recap and the spreadsheet  attaching our standard vendor questionnaire as well (Novamed_Vendor_Questionnaire.docx). A couple quick clarifications from our security team before they start filling the SIG: 

- SOC 2: Is Redwood SOC 2 Type II certified today, and can you share the latest attestation date and scope?
- PHI handling: We will be sending clinical notes that contain PHI. Can you confirm whether Redwood has a HIPAA BA agreement and whether you support a BA in hosted/dedicated/private deployments?
- Encryption: For data at rest and in transit, can you provide the algorithms/strength (e.g., AES-256 at rest, TLS 1.2/1.3 in transit)?
- Logs: Do audit logs include full request bodies by default? If so, is there a redaction option?

We can aim to return the SIG spreadsheet by 2026-12-08 but wanted to surface these items up front. If Marissa or someone from your security team can provide short answers, that will help our InfoSec reviewers.

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sarah Liu <sarah.liu@novamed.com>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-12-02T08:35:00-08:00
Subject: Re: SIG questionnaire initiation  Novamed (SOC 2 / HIPAA)

Hi Sarah 

Thanks for the questions  Im Marissa on Redwoods Security & Compliance team. Quick answers below to help your team proceed: 

- SOC 2: Redwood is SOC 2 Type II certified; latest report completed audit period ended 2026-06-30. We can share the bridge letter and the full report under NDA / secure portal.
- HIPAA / BA: We support HIPAA and execute a Business Associate Agreement for customers handling PHI. For hosted deployments we provide a BA; for certain regulated customers we recommend Dedicated or Private deployments and well scope that in the BA.
- Encryption:
  - At rest: AES-256 (FIPS 140-2 compliant KMS integration available)
  - In transit: TLS 1.2+ (TLS 1.3 preferred)
- Audit logs: By default, we retain request metadata and non-sensitive request IDs. Full request bodies are NOT stored by default for hosted customers; we provide configurable logging levels and a redaction configuration if you need to ensure PHI is not persisted. For Dedicated/Private deployments, customers control log retention and can opt into additional controls.

Follow-ups Id propose: 
- We can upload SOC 2 artifacts to a secure portal (Ill send link once an NDA/portal access is set).
- If Novamed needs a BA, Camila let me know and Ill loop Legal  we can typically turn a BA in 711 business days once scope is agreed.
- If useful, Im happy to join a 30-min call to walk through the SIG and answer any technical questions (available Mon/Tue mornings PST).

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Security & Compliance Lead
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
